areas.name: East Village
areas.summary: Lebendiges, vielfältiges Viertel mit vielen Bars und Essensangeboten, besonders rund um St. Marks Place.

nightlife.why: Viele Bars und eine Gruppe japanischer Bars – „The East Village also has lots of bars, as well as a sizeable cluster of Japanese bars.“

food.why: Vielfältige Lokale, immer etwas los – „This colorful neighborhood is full of eateries as diverse as its population, and there's always something happening on St. Marks Place, 24/7.“

safety.why: Kriminalität heute deutlich gesunken, Obdachlose sichtbar – „but the neighborhood, like the rest of New York, is way lower in crime“

areas.name: Greenwich Village
areas.summary: Ruhigeres Wohnviertel mit Charme, Bäumen und Restaurants rund um den Washington Square Park.

nightlife.why: Gute Mischung aus Bars und Ausgehangeboten – „Greenwich Village is probably the best neighborhood to go if you are in town for just a brief period“

food.why: Einige der besten Restaurants und Bars westlich der University Place – „West of University Place are many historic and attractive brownstones and some of the city's best restaurants and bars“

transit.why: Busse nur entlang der Avenues, viele Seitenstraßen zu Fuß – „It is possible to take some of the aforementioned buses along the avenues in the Village“

nature.why: Baumgesäumte Straßen und Washington Square Park – „the Village is still worth a visit for its lovely tree-lined streets and colorful history“

areas.name: Lower East Side
areas.summary: Altes Einwandererviertel, heute Mix aus Bars, Musikclubs, Traditionsläden und Boutiquen.

nightlife.why: Sehr beliebt zum Trinken und Ausgehen – „The Lower East Side is a very popular neighborhood for drinking, especially on the part of young people“

quiet.why: Am Wochenende sehr voll und laut – „especially on weekend nights, it can be uncomfortably packed, with tremendous crowding on the streets as well as on lines to get into bars“

food.why: Traditionelle Lokale mit Pastrami und Bialys – „a venerable old no-nonsense place that just might serve up the best pastrami sandwich in the world“
